problem_and_solution.description: Is the problem urgent and clearly defined? Is the solution directly addressing it in a way that is easy to understand from the deck alone?

value_proposition.description: Does the deck clearly explain why this is better than competitors? Is the unique selling point (USP) compelling and well-articulated?

originality.description: Is the idea innovative and not just a direct copy of existing solutions? Does it bring a fresh approach to the problem?

target_market.description: Is the TAM/SAM/SOM clearly defined with credible sizing? Is the target customer segment specific and well-understood?

market_validation.description: Is there proof of market interest such as prototypes, traction, letters of intent, or user feedback? Is demand evidenced rather than assumed?

business_model.description: Is it clear how the company makes money? Are revenue streams logical and sustainable?

team_strength.description: Does the team possess the necessary skills and experience to execute? Are relevant backgrounds and roles clearly presented?

milestones_and_ask.description: Is there a clear, realistic plan for growth? Is the funding ask specific with a defined use of funds and measurable milestones?

slide_clarity.description: Are the slides uncluttered with one key idea per slide? Does each headline deliver the key takeaway without needing a presenter to explain it?

visual_quality.description: Are graphs, charts, and images high-quality and easy to read? Is the deck visually professional and free of messy design?

branding_consistency.description: Are fonts, colours, and branding consistent and professional throughout the deck?

social_environmental_impact.description: Does the pitch address a meaningful social or environmental issue? Is the broader impact clearly articulated?

financial_model.description: Are the financial projections realistic and clearly supported by assumptions? Are key metrics such as CAC, LTV, and burn rate addressed?

standalone_narrative.description: Does the deck tell a coherent story on its own without a presenter? Is the flow logical and self-explanatory from first slide to last?
